prompts.kagura:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an original 2D fighting game. Create exactly ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows (24 cells, each 256x256). NO labels, text, grid lines, borders, backdrop, floor, or cast shadows. Transparent background. Every cell contains the SAME fighter, full body, SIDE VIEW FACING RIGHT, consistent clothing, anatomy, proportions and sprite scale. Authentic meticulously hand-pixelled mid-1990s premium arcade fighting game aesthetic: bold expressive anatomy, exquisite chunky pixel clusters, strong dark colored outlines, 4-tone cel shading, selective highlights, saturated restrained palette, no anti-aliased painting, no 3D. Each figure approx 155 pixels tall at standing pose; feet baseline at local y=224, pelvis centered on local x=112; leave ample padding for weapon and attacks within own cell. Every pose must stay entirely inside its cell. 24 distinct hand-drawn animation keyframes in strict row-major order:
Row 1: [0] idle guard A, [1] idle guard B breathing with scarf changed, [2] walk leading foot forward, [3] walk passing step, [4] walk opposite foot forward, [5] walk second passing step.
Row 2: [6] low crouching guard, [7] jump with knees tucked, [8] standing attack windup, [9] light attack extended RIGHT, [10] heavy attack fully extended RIGHT, [11] recovery from heavy attack.
Row 3: [12] crouching low attack extended RIGHT, [13] jumping attack extended RIGHT, [14] special projectile casting RIGHT, [15] rising uppercut/sword strike RIGHT, [16] forward rushing attack RIGHT, [17] ultimate powerful attack RIGHT with modest character-colored energy arc.
Row 4: [18] standing recoil after being hit, [19] midair falling backwards hurt, [20] knocked down lying horizontal head LEFT feet RIGHT at ground baseline, [21] standing blocking RIGHT, [22] forward grab RIGHT, [23] victory pose.
No duplicate cells; arms and legs actually change poses. Anatomically clear silhouette and consistent recognizable face. Transparent clean gaps between all 24 cells. Original design, do not reproduce an existing franchise character.
CHARACTER: KAGURA, fierce adult Japanese male flame swordsman, wiry athletic powerful build, unruly dark indigo ponytail, crimson scarf flowing behind him to the LEFT, sleeveless red and charcoal samurai jacket, black hakama trousers, gold belt buckle, wrapped forearms and shin guards, dark tabi boots, scarred intense face. Curved polished silver katana with golden guard in forward hand, black scabbard at hip. Rich scarlet, charcoal, warm skin and gold palette. Distinct heroic elegant silhouette. Attacks use the katana.
